title: ColorRoleSystem
description: Named background/primary/secondary/accent (+ optional extended) color roles and the deterministic rule for assigning them from a resolved Palette's color array. New in Design Intelligence Core Phase 1 — formalizes app/src/trend/designIntelligence.ts's deriveColorRoles() as externally-editable data. Distinct from engine/motifFactory.ts's unrelated per-motif colorRoles field (a 'which colors did this motif actually use' audit list, not a role-assignment system).
